text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Observed power and forecasts for 20 December 2025 to 3 January 2026, as a percentage of capacity, from one XGBoost model per substation trained on ERA5 weather, with each configuration adding columns to the base. Mean of three fitting seeds. The lowest panel averages the forecasts and the observed power over the 14 series.'
text.tspan: Observed power and forecasts for 20 December 2025 to 3 January 2026, as a percentage of capacity, from one XGBoost model
per substation trained on ERA5 weather, with each configuration adding columns to the base. Mean of three fitting seeds.
The lowest panel averages the forecasts and the observed power over the 14 series.
